Title: Health Check Alerts
Description: Tells you when a scheduled health check finds a problem, and says nothing when it doesn't. Umbraco's own health check email lists every check, counts warnings as success so a warnings-only run sends nothing, and never says which site it came from. Health Check Alerts sends only when a run has a warning or an error, lists just those with errors first and a read more link, names the site and environment, goes to one address or many, and never sends from a developer's local copy. It doesn't repeat unchanged problems, tells you when they are resolved, lets you snooze a known problem until a date, and can post a JSON webhook. Settings, a send test alert button and snoozes live in a back office dashboard and apply from the next run with no deploy. Works on Umbraco Cloud, including the Starter plan. Free and MIT licensed.
